summary_1line: Sahadeva prays to Agni, is tested and blessed, then subdues many southern kings for Yudhishthira’s campaign before Nakula’s western expedition is introduced.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sahadeva sits on kusa grass before anxious troops as the god Agni appears in flames and speaks to him.
Agni rising in radiant fire before the kneeling Sahadeva who bows with folded hands.
Messengers from the shore deliver tribute of jewels, pearls, and sandalwood sent by Vibhishana to Sahadeva.
